decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch within the core dumper range that still has its own product page in 2024, it remains a low-cost, strategically fitting option worth keeping while demand continues to clarify.
This articulated dumper is also close to the established business and still prominently marketed in 2024, so the option value of staying in the line is higher than the likely carrying cost.

The move from a dedicated page in 2023 to only a mention in 2024, combined with its greater distance from the firm’s main range, suggests the option has weakened and resources are better redeployed elsewhere.
The compact telescopic loader fits the firm’s established construction and lifting capabilities and its continued full presentation in 2024 indicates enough promise to retain it.
Although newly launched in 2024, the reported large order and statement that it is the most popular rental material lift strongly support continued commercialization.
Despite being more distant from the core range, the strong early operating evidence and dedicated 2024 product page make it a promising option that should be kept for now.
